text:
Renee (CS): quick alert 1 tenants in APAC/EMEA report onboarding timeouts after yesterdays onboarding deployment. Need an external note + a high-touch variant for renewal-risk accounts.
Omar (Eng): root cause: a cert chain rotation left an intermediate cert expired for some agent versions; affected agents reject handshake. Rollback applied, workers restarted. Automated retry queued; ETA 4h to finish. No credentials accessed.
Felix (AE): for renewal-risk accounts offer a live setup call + billing credit for the impacted day. Ill coordinate scheduling.
Sofia (Localization): I can translate to fr/de/ja in 40m after final copy.
Renee (CS): draft (general):
Hi <Customer>,
Were sorry 1 onboarding connections may have failed due to a certificate rotation issue. We rolled back the intermediate certificate to restore TLS handshakes and queued automated retries which should complete within ~4 hours.
If youd like immediate assistance: in the console go to Connections > Retry, or reply and we'll replay for you within 1 hour.
No credentials or customer data were exposed.
Well apply a one-time credit for the affected window. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2460001234
Renee (CS): high-touch variant adds: "Your CSM will schedule a 1:1 within 30m and prioritize tenant replay."
Omar (Eng): OK. Add "rollback performed at 2460001500" in notes.
audit-bot: Incident 2460001234 status: mitigation in progress 1 rollback performed.
Renee (CS): subject: "Onboarding update: connection issue resolved (next steps)" preheader: "Retry available; CSM help for priority accounts". Felix  will own priority outreach. Ready to send after translations.
Felix (AE): will start outreach and flag renewal risk tenants to CS sheet.
